references.text: Describes the same principle regarding cities of refuge where the manslayer shall be safe from the avenger of blood until he stands before the assembly for judgment.
Explains the difference between intentional murder and unintentional killing, stating that one who kills without enmity or without planning it shall be protected.
Parallel text describing the same law concerning cities of refuge for someone who kills their neighbor without intent and without prior enmity.
Contrast showing what happens when someone hates their neighbor and kills intentionally - then the elders must hand him over to the avenger of blood.
Defines the role of the avenger of blood - he shall himself kill the murderer when he encounters him.
The basis for the cities of refuge - God will designate a place where one who kills unintentionally may flee.
